creator.name: Zetsubou
creator.title: Illustrious Character LoRA Showcase
creator.description: Character LoRA training focused on canon looks, flexible prompting, and anime screenshot-style outputs.

focusCards.title: Side & background character focus
focusCards.description: Training work built for characters that often have limited references, inconsistent frames, or very few clean public examples.

focusCards.title: Manual dataset preparation
focusCards.description: Curated image selection, cropping, cleanup, and hand-authored tags keep each LoRA aligned with the intended character identity.

focusCards.title: Canon look preservation
focusCards.description: Default outfits, face shape, hair details, and signature visual cues are tested before a collection is published.

focusCards.title: Screenshot-style direction
focusCards.description: Showcases are tuned toward anime-still composition, controlled lighting, and readable character-first outputs.

workflow.title: Source review
workflow.description: Compare official references, screenshots, manga panels, and user-facing examples to define the target look.

workflow.title: Dataset selection
workflow.description: Choose frames that preserve identity while avoiding duplicates, noisy crops, and misleading poses.

workflow.title: Cropping
workflow.description: Prepare portrait, upper-body, and contextual crops so the model learns both detail and overall silhouette.

workflow.title: Manual tagging
workflow.description: Write tags by hand for outfit, hair, expression, pose, and scene details that need flexible prompting.

workflow.title: Training
workflow.description: Train around IL / SDXL workflows with conservative settings and version checks.

workflow.title: Testing
workflow.description: Run canon outfit, alternate outfit, screenshot-style, and negative prompt checks.

workflow.title: Prompt tips / delivery notes
workflow.description: Publish notes that explain trigger words, reliable tags, and known limits for each LoRA.

caseStudies.title: Manga-only character
caseStudies.description: Adapting a limited black-and-white source into colored anime-style outputs while keeping the design recognizable.

caseStudies.title: Limited source character
caseStudies.description: Balancing a small dataset with manual tags and careful testing so a background character remains usable.

caseStudies.title: Default outfit preservation
caseStudies.description: Keeping the canon outfit stable while still allowing promptable alternate clothing in separate tests.

caseStudies.title: Anime screenshot coloring
caseStudies.description: Using prompt and dataset choices to steer outputs toward polished frame-like scenes instead of generic portraits.

commissions.title: Private IL Character LoRA
commissions.description: A private character LoRA package prepared for personal use and delivered with usage notes.

commissions.title: Public Bulk Pack
commissions.description: Multiple public releases planned as a themed batch or character set.

commissions.title: Private Bulk Pack
commissions.description: A private multi-character training request with scoped priorities and delivery notes.

selectedAdaptations.title: Selected Adaptations
selectedAdaptations.description: A focused shortlist of series where the source material needs extra adaptation work before it becomes a clean Illustrious character LoRA showcase.

items.title: Gokusotsu Kraken
items.description: Manga-source character work where limited references, grayscale panels, and outfit quirks need extra curation before the final LoRA feels flexible.
items.whyMatters: This is the kind of series where manual selection and honest limitation notes matter more than simply dumping every panel into training.
notes: Useful for showing multiple character LoRAs from the same source

items.title: Indonesian Webtoon
items.description: A manhwa/webtoon collection imported from CivitAI and organized as a readable portfolio entry instead of a loose list of models.
items.whyMatters: It shows how imported public models can still be presented with clearer series grouping, source labels, and viewer-friendly showcase cards.
notes: Good stress test for mixed PG / PG-13 / R variants

items.title: No Man's Land
items.description: A larger source set with many characters, making it useful for showing consistent collection structure across a lot of LoRA entries.
items.whyMatters: Large collections make weak admin tooling painful fast, so this section is a good place to highlight series that benefit from local editing and clear curation.
notes: Useful for checking card order and section copy
